blocks.arabic_text: قَرَابَةً، اَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونِّيْ، وَاُحْسِنُ اِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيْئُوْنَ اِلَيَّ، وَاَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُوْنَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ: لَئِنْ كُنْتَ كَمَا قُلْتَ، فَكَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ الْمَلَّ، وَلَا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللهِ ظَهِيْرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ، مَا دُمْتَ عَلي ذلِكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب صلة الرحم...، رقم:٦٥٢٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates: A man complained to the Prophet ﷺ, “Ya Rasulallah! I have some relatives; I wish to live in harmony with them, but they cut off their connection with me. I treat them in a beautiful manner, and they treat me in an evil manner. I bear with them when they transgress against me, and they behave ignorantly with me.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “If the situation is as you say, then you are stuffing hot ashes into their mouths, and as long as you remain steadfast in this conduct, a helper from Allah Ta'ala will be with you at all times.”

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْذُوْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتََسَبُوْا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوْا بُهْتَاناً وَّاِثْمًا مُّبِيْنًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Those who harm the believing men and the believing women for what they have not done have certainly borne upon themselves slander and a manifest sin.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Harming with the tongue is slander; harming with the other limbs
